name: SharePoint+OneDrive document-cloud graph ingestion (Outlook + personal/P2P comms STRICTLY off-graph)
description: NFRA_EXPAND Strand A (Andrew-direct 2026-06-25). Graph the SharePoint sites/libraries + OneDrive trees (the document/file clouds) into globgrph via the m365 gateway's delegated Graph API -- nodes (site/library/folder/file) + edges (contains/owned-by/has-access/shared-with) + activity metadata (lastModified/lastAccessed). HARD SCOPE BOUNDARY (Andrew, load-bearing, enforced IN CODE not by convention): OUTLOOK (email+calendar) + ALL personal/peer-to-peer comms (Teams chats/DMs) are STRICTLY OFF-GRAPH -- the ingestion never calls the mail/calendar/chat Graph surfaces. STRUCTURE/METADATA/ACTIVITY ONLY, never CONTENT (file bodies never graphed). GRAPH: a single AWS Nessie globgrph (Andrew-direct, not federated). Access-topology (who-has-access/shared-with incl users) IS RETAINED -- org-internal access topology is SECURITY-VALID not a privacy concern (Andrew-direct); only Outlook/personal-comms + file CONTENT are excluded. Access NOW = Andrew-only; Entra-ID-based access provisioning is a dedicated later phase ('phase 2 of this project', Andrew). The major build; prereq for the GLOBAL heat_map (Strand C-global). Resolved (Andrew): access-topology retained (security), single AWS Nessie graph. Open CTO-design: cadence/delta-sync, scale/granularity, activity source -- in the PRD.
